name: Command Palette
description: Ctrl+P fuzzy file finder overlay. Displays a search input with results list. On first search, performs throttled recursive directory walk (skips .git, node_modules, .cockpit). Filters files by name or path matching search term (case-insensitive), returns top 50. Stores up to 10 recent files in localStorage under 'cockpit-recent-files' key. Empty input shows recent files. Arrow key navigation with visual highlight. Enter selects and opens file. Escape closes palette. Overlay click outside dismisses. Debounced 150ms search input.

interface.constructor: constructor(wsPath: string, onSelect: (filePath: string) => void) — Creates .palette-overlay (role=dialog, aria-modal) containing .palette > input.palette-input + .palette-progress + .palette-results. Loads recent files from localStorage('cockpit-recent-files'). Registers input event (debounced 150ms search), keydown (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape), overlay click (dismiss if target === overlay). Appends overlay to document.body.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Sets isOpen=true, adds .open class to overlay, clears input and results, resets selectedIndex and allFiles/filesLoaded flags, renders recent files, focuses input after 50ms.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets isOpen=false, removes .open class from overlay, clears any pending search timer.

lifecycle.created_by: ExplorerPlugin.openFileSearch() — lazily created on first Ctrl+P invocation, stored as ExplorerPlugin.palette
lifecycle.destroyed_by: When ExplorerPlugin instance destroyed (card termination), overlay removed from DOM
